save_checkpoint: save a pytorch model and optimizer state dict to a checkpoint file at the current epoch
load_checkpoint: load a pytorch model and optimizer state dict from a checkpoint file and return the saved epoch
get_checkpoint_last: get the file path of the most recently saved checkpoint in the checkpoints directory
has_checkpoint: check if any checkpoint files exist in the configured checkpoints directory
is_checkpoint_epoch: determine if a checkpoint should be saved at the current epoch based on the configured checkpoint period
